item.title: Version 1.5.9
item.changes: Vignette, Lens Effects and Tonal Contrast as adjustment layers, and the Filter menu now lists the filters that can be adjustment layers first. Adjustment layers are much faster: their results are kept while nothing under them changes, and RGB Split, Bokeh and Starburst are several times quicker. Lens Effects layers look exactly as the Filter menu and Copy Merged make them.
